detailed_descriptions_html.en:
WARSHIFT 2 is a unique mix of Action, Strategy and Role-playing gameplay elements. You can build bases, manage troops, and then come down to keep your enemy at gunpoint in the dynamic battle and customize your main characters. Created by a solo indie developer, this project set out to bring a fresh take to the RTS genre by combining strategic command with direct action gameplay.

ACTION-RTS GAMEPLAY

  • Toggle between Third Person Action and Strategy modes in real-time on the battlefield

  • Real-Time Strategy gameplay: manage troops, Aircraft Carriers, Battleships

  • Dynamic battles army against hordes of enemies

CUSTOMIZATION

  • Customize, upgrade and evolve systems for the Heroes (combat avatars)

  • Dozens of weapons, support drones, turrets and other upgrades

  • Each Hero has unique super-ability and it's own weapons

HEAVY UNITS TACTICS

  • Create and command your army, buildings and defensive towers

  • Economic component: extraction of resources and creating energy is critical for success

  • Tactical component: manage heavy units, aircraft carriers and flying battleships for massive destruction

  • Order an orbital mass destruction weapons

ENVIRONMENT

  • Ground, Air, Water, Volcanic, Underwater and Outer Space environments

  • Single player campaigns including interactive training missions

  • Custom skirmishes vs AI - near-infinite combination and replayability

BACKGROUND

 In the near future, humanity faces an aggressive biomechanical civilization determined to consume all forms of life. Frontier planets turn into battlegrounds where war cyborgs, heavy machinery, and bio-engineered beasts clash for every meter of territory.

Players take the role of commanders who can both lead armies from above and personally enter the fight by controlling hero-units in real time. Your mission is to hold the invasion, build your defenses, and turn the tide of the conflict across large-scale ground and space operations.

Worlds fall. Armies evolve. The future is decided in WARSHIFT 2.

ABOUT

WARSHIFT 2 is a sequel to the original WARSHIFT game, that is developed entirely by a solo developer - Cyril Megem, who is both game designer, artist and programmer in this project. He worked hard for many years to implement a lot of his and the game community's ideas.
